reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 15 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Spurs win 89 times in 100, by about 16; most games like this end between 201 and 250 total points.

analyst.text: San Antonio are fresh: no starter played more than 25 minutes in Friday's rout of Golden State, and Steve Kerr called them the best team in the league. Utah have lost 11 straight without Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr., and Will Hardy said the streak 'has been very revealing of the character of the team' after calling parts of the Houston loss unacceptable. The news angle leans clearly towards the Spurs.
